title: 9 Bangladeshi nationals killed in massive fire at Kolkata hotel
content: A Kolkata hotel fire claimed nine lives early Wednesday morning.  Six individuals sustained injuries and received immediate medical attention.  Meanwhile, a separate incident in Birbhum resulted in seven fatalities.  This second fire occurred at a private hotel in Tarapith on Tuesday.  Investigations into the causes of both tragic fires are currently underway.

title: Goa moves SC seeking life term for Tarun Tejpal in sexual assault case
content: In a significant move, the Goa government has approached the Supreme Court, requesting a harsher sentence for Tarun Tejpal in a sexual assault case. The state argues that his current penalty is insufficient given the severity of the crime. They emphasize that Tejpal exploited his position of power, suggesting that time should not lessen the consequences for such an offense.

title: Pant scripts history, leapfrogs Gill to become India’s top WTC run-scorer
content: In a remarkable feat, Rishabh Pant has now taken the lead in India's World Test Championship run charts, overtaking Shubman Gill following his impressive performance in Galle. Pant's milestone of achieving 100 Test sixes marks a historic moment for Indian cricket. Following him in the standings are Rohit Sharma and Ravindra Jadeja, while Joe Root continues to hold the overall lead in World Test Championship runs.

title: Imran Khan’s sister meets him after 9 months as Pak SC orders hospital transfer
content: Noreen Niazi met her brother Imran Khan in Adiala Jail after nine months. The Supreme Court ordered weekly family meetings and his transfer to a hospital. Imran also met his wife, Bushra Bibi, for a longer duration. Medical reports indicated fluctuating blood pressure and anxiety for the former prime minister. The court stressed family access as a fundamental right, not a concession.

title: Within 6 months, ChatGPT can watch your screen, meetings & emails: CEO Altman
content: Sam Altman envisions a future where AI assistants can observe user activities on screens and during meetings. These intuitive systems are designed to access emails, documents, and Slack messages for better context and efficiency. Users will have control over the type of information that AI can interface with, potentially transforming the workplace dynamics. Altman predicts this revolutionary capability could become available within six months.

title: Bhopal cops hunt for private parts of boy killed by 'testicle traffickers'
content: Police divers will search Bhopal's lakes for testicles removed by a gang.  A 20-year-old student allegedly led the group after seeing a social media hoax.  They failed to find a buyer for the organs and then disposed of them.  The victim was a 16-year-old boy murdered for a supposed sale.  Investigators are now trying to recover crucial evidence from the murky waters.

title: Bus takes different route, passenger misses flight; commission orders Rs 73K payout
content: A consumer commission ordered Greenline Travels to pay compensation for a significant delay. The bus company's route deviation caused a passenger to miss his flight to Delhi. The complainant was pursuing an M.Phil. and needed to reach Delhi for his course. The commission found the company deficient in service for the unexplained delay. Greenline Travels must pay Rs 73,000 for flight, accommodation, and mental agony.

title: Hawaii’s 1905 mosquitofish import now linked to native species decline
content: The introduction of mosquitofish in Hawaii has dramatically affected the ecosystem, leading to notable declines in native aquatic insects. These invasive fish fiercely prey on local species, disrupting food chains. The native damselflies, unprepared for such predation, are particularly vulnerable, seeing their populations plummet. Additionally, mosquitofish compete with endemic fish and crustaceans for limited food resources, complicating control efforts due to intricate waterways and their fast breeding habits.

title: Farmer left 377-acre wheat field wild in 1988; it’s now a major wildlife refuge
content: An abandoned wheat farm in England has been transformed into a thriving nature reserve after decades of neglect. Following a dedicated public campaign, £1.5 million was raised to acquire the land, ensuring its protection for future generations. This 377-acre area now boasts a rich variety of wildlife, including numerous endangered bird species, and will be overseen by the Wildlife Trust as a cherished habitat.

title: Monarch butterflies added to endangered list; scientists use solar-powered backpacks
content: To protect the endangered monarch butterfly, researchers are harnessing the power of tiny solar-equipped devices for monitoring. These trackers provide valuable data on how butterflies interact with their overwintering habitats and locate nearby nectar sources. With small radio telemetry devices attached to them, scientists can study these creatures more effectively in California's coastal areas. Moreover, the initiative invites citizen scientists to contribute their own observations through an easy-to-use mobile application.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott's donations have enabled medical debt abolition across America. Her model allows acquiring and erasing patient debt at steep discounts. This approach has inspired other billionaires to contribute millions to similar initiatives. While philanthropic efforts provide immediate relief, policy reform remains stalled. Lasting change may require systemic reforms addressing the root causes of medical debt.

title: US-Canada tariff row eases: Trump pauses 50% levies after last-minute deal
content: The United States and Canada have agreed to delay significant tariffs on imports. This pause allows both nations more time to negotiate a comprehensive trade agreement. President Donald Trump announced the tariff delay on social media after last-minute talks. The tariffs would have impacted approximately five percent of Canadian exports to the US. This development occurs amid already strained relations between the two countries.

title: Travis Kelce expands business empire with major move for college athletes
content: Travis Kelce is preparing for the 2026 NFL season while expanding his career beyond football. The Chiefs tight end has teamed with Publicis Group and 3 Arts Entertainment to launch Tekta, a consulting service designed to connect college athletes with NIL opportunities while offering guidance on branding, partnerships and financial literacy. The move adds to Kelce’s growing business portfolio as speculation continues over whether 2026 could be his final NFL season.

title: Chris Evert reveals how motherhood brought her a deeper kind of happiness
content: Chris Evert’s words about not wanting to leave her first child’s side show how deeply motherhood changed her life. After years of success in tennis, the birth of Alexander made her see happiness differently. Her three sons became her greatest pride, and Evert has continued to describe being their mother as the most meaningful part of her life.

title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' $5 million gift creates lasting legacy
content: Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes and his wife Brittany Mahomes' $5 million donation to Texas Tech marks a transformative moment for the university's football facilities. This substantial amount amplifies the fundraising efforts and ensures naming rights for prominent sections of the new complex. With Patrick's rich history at Texas Tech, their generosity underscores a lasting commitment to elevating the school's athletic programs to new heights.

title: 'Wife wanted to start new life': More skeletons tumble out in Bengaluru double murder

They allegedly planned the husband's death, which escalated when the child witnessed the attack. The couple then decided to kill the four-year-old son as well. Investigators suspect financial and personal motives behind the brutal crime.

title: Democrat Angie Nixon defeats Alexander Vindman in surprise Florida Senate primary upset

These primaries set the stage for Florida's November political direction.

title: US vs ICC row escalates: Trump admin sanctions int'l court president, senior lawyer
content: In a significant escalation against the International Criminal Court (ICC), the United States has imposed sanctions on two prominent officials, including the ICC president and a senior trial lawyer. This move marks a continuation of the Trump administration's contentious stance towards the internationally recognized tribunal. The ICC criticized these sanctions as detrimental to the global legal framework, while several European allies voiced their concern over the U.S. actions.

title: India vs Pak Hockey WC: Knockout dream, survival at stake in blockbuster clash

England have already secured a place in the next round after winning both their matches. The historic Wagener Stadium in Amstelveen will host this high-pressure contest. This match revives one of hockey's most storied rivalries with significant implications.

title: 'Awarapan 2' Day 5: Emraan Hashmi scores first Rs 100cr solo hit with 122% ROI

After a strong opening day with Rs 22 crore, the film experienced substantial growth over the weekend. With a net collection of Rs 100.75 crore in India and a total of Rs 144.13 crore globally, the film's success is noteworthy considering its budget of Rs 45 crore.

title: Trump's voter ID praise follows Gyanesh Kumar - Sergio Gor meet

He emphasized that the rigorous examination of elections by political parties contributes to high public trust in the electoral process.

title: Captain of ship attacked in Hormuz dead or alive? SC seeks report from government

After DNA tests disproved his presumed death following a ship attack, the court is now requesting a status report on the efforts to locate him from the Solicitor General by Monday.

title: NTA removes 600 experts, brings 4-tier paper checks
